verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents ways to get data out in standard forms: standard SSH clients and `scp` can copy files out of a sandbox, persistent files can be read and managed without resuming compute, and historical logs, metrics and the audit ledger are readable via API. None of this is framed as a complete data-export or exit path. missing for 10: a documented bulk or account-wide export feature, export of snapshots/RootFS/templates in open formats (e.g. OCI images or tarballs), a stated export format for logs and the audit ledger, and any data-portability or offboarding guidance.
